description: A research paper's text as published, by slug, with its headings; send section for one part, and max_chars to cap the length. Find the slug with search_research or list_topics first.

max_chars.description: Most characters of text to return; default 12000.

section.description: Return only the section whose heading contains this text; the result lists every heading.

name: get_paper

outputSchema.description: text is the paper as published (or the requested section); headings list its sections; truncated says whether max_chars cut it.

title: Read a paper
